import * as React from "react" import { CalendarIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@/components/ui/select" import { MeterBar } from "@/components/ds/meter-bar" import { ModelIcon, type ModelFamily } from "@/components/ds/model-icons" import { NumberTicker } from "@/components/ds/number-ticker" import { Stat, StatLabel, StatMeta, StatUnit, StatValue } from "@/components/ds/stat" import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/ds/status" import { Widget, WidgetActions, WidgetFooter, WidgetHeader, WidgetList, WidgetListHeader, WidgetListRow, WidgetMeta, WidgetPanel, WidgetSectionTitle, WidgetTitle, } from "@/components/ds/widget" // AI spend: this month's cost by model against a monthly budget, with an // alert past 80%. Pick a past month to see the other states. const BUDGET = 1500 const ALERT = 0.8 const MODELS: { id: string; name: string; provider: string; family: ModelFamily; color: string }[] = [ { id: "opus", name: "Claude Opus", provider: "Anthropic", family: "claude", color: "var(--chart-1)" }, { id: "sonnet", name: "Claude Sonnet", provider: "Anthropic", family: "claude", color: "var(--chart-2)" }, { id: "gpt", name: "GPT", provider: "OpenAI", family: "openai", color: "var(--chart-3)" }, { id: "gemini", name: "Gemini", provider: "Google", family: "gemini", color: "var(--chart-4)" }, { id: "llama", name: "Llama", provider: "Self-hosted", family: "meta", color: "var(--muted-foreground)" }, ] type Month = { label: string short: string days: number /** Days elapsed; equal to `days` for a closed month. */ day: number resets: string /** Cost and tokens (millions) per model id. */ usage: Record } const MONTHS: Record = { oct: { label: "October 2026", short: "Oct", days: 31, day: 19, resets: "Nov 1", usage: { opus: { cost: 584.2, tokens: 37.7 }, sonnet: { cost: 398.7, tokens: 78.2 }, gpt: { cost: 182.6, tokens: 41 }, gemini: { cost: 91.15, tokens: 23.8 }, llama: { cost: 30.4, tokens: 15.6 }, }, }, sep: { label: "September 2026", short: "Sep", days: 30, day: 30, resets: "Oct 1", usage: { opus: { cost: 702.4, tokens: 45.3 }, sonnet: { cost: 455.1, tokens: 89.2 }, gpt: { cost: 259.8, tokens: 58.4 }, gemini: { cost: 140.2, tokens: 36.6 }, llama: { cost: 54.9, tokens: 28.1 }, }, }, aug: { label: "August 2026", short: "Aug", days: 31, day: 31, resets: "Sep 1", usage: { opus: { cost: 280.4, tokens: 18.1 }, sonnet: { cost: 210.3, tokens: 41.2 }, gpt: { cost: 99.6, tokens: 22.4 }, gemini: { cost: 49.7, tokens: 13 }, llama: { cost: 16.6, tokens: 8.5 }, }, }, } const usd = (v: number, digits = 0) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits }) const COLS = "grid-cols-[1fr_64px_80px_44px]" export function AiSpend() { const [monthKey, setMonthKey] = React.useState("oct") const [hovered, setHovered] = React.useState(null) const month = MONTHS[monthKey] const spent = MODELS.reduce((sum, m) => sum + month.usage[m.id].cost, 0) const ratio = spent / BUDGET const open = month.day < month.days const projected = open ? (spent / month.day) * month.days : spent const capDay = Math.ceil(BUDGET / (spent / month.day)) // Tone escalates with severity: fine → close to the cap → over it. const level = ratio >= 1 ? "over" : ratio > ALERT ? "alert" : "ok" return ( AI spend
Spent usd(v)} /> / {usd(BUDGET)} {level === "over" ? `${usd(spent - BUDGET)} over budget` : `${usd(BUDGET - spent)} left`} {open ? "Projected" : "Daily average"} {usd(open ? projected : spent / month.days)} {open ? `Resets ${month.resets}` : "Closed month"}
({ id: m.id, value: month.usage[m.id].cost, color: m.color }))} markers={[ { value: BUDGET * ALERT, label: `${Math.round(ALERT * 100)}%` }, { value: BUDGET, label: "Budget" }, ]} highlighted={hovered} /> {level !== "ok" && (
{level === "over" ? ( Over budget ) : ( {Math.round(ratio * 100)}% used )} {level === "over" ? `Went over the budget around ${month.short} ${capDay}.` : open && capDay <= month.days ? `At this pace the budget runs out around ${month.short} ${capDay}.` : "Close to the monthly budget."}
)} setHovered(null)}> By model Tokens Cost Share {MODELS.map((m) => { const u = month.usage[m.id] return ( setHovered(m.id)} > {m.name} {m.provider} {u.tokens.toFixed(1)}M {usd(u.cost, 2)} {Math.round((u.cost / spent) * 100)}% ) })} Budget {usd(BUDGET)} / month · alert at {Math.round(ALERT * 100)}% ) }
